verses.text: Dear friends, this is now the second letter I have written to you. In both letters I have tried to get you thinking clearly by reminding you of things.
I want you to remember the words the holy prophets spoke long ago, and the command that our Lord and Saviour gave through your apostles.
First of all, you must understand that in the last days people will come who laugh at the truth and follow their own wrong desires.
They will say, "Jesus promised to come back. So where is he? Since our ancestors died, everything has carried on just as it has since the world was made."
But they choose to forget that long ago God made the heavens by his word. He formed the earth out of water and with water.
Then he used water to flood and destroy that world.
By the same word, the heavens and the earth that exist now are being kept for fire. They are being kept for the day when God will judge and destroy people who do not care about him.
Dear friends, do not forget this one thing: to the Lord, one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like one day.
The Lord is not slow to keep his promise, as some people think. Instead, he is being patient with you. He does not want anyone to be destroyed. He wants everyone to turn away from their sins.

But the day of the Lord will come as suddenly as a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud roar. Everything in them will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done on it will be burned up.
Since everything will be destroyed like this, what kind of people should you be? You should live holy lives that honour God,
as you wait for the day of God and work to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything in them will melt in the heat.
But we are waiting for what God promised: new heavens and a new earth, where everything is right and good.
So, dear friends, while you are waiting for this, try your hardest to be at peace with God, and to be pure and without fault in his eyes.
Remember that our Lord is patient so that people can be saved. Our dear brother Paul wrote to you about this too, with the wisdom God gave him.

He writes about these things in all his letters. Some things in them are hard to understand. People who do not know better and whose faith is weak twist their meaning, just as they twist the other Scriptures. In the end, they destroy themselves.
Dear friends, you already know these things. So be careful, so that you are not led away by the mistakes of evil people and lose your firm footing.
But grow in the kindness and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. Glory to him, now and forever! Amen.
